output.one_liner: Team communication platform offering messaging, channels, file sharing, and video conferencing with API and MCP integration support.

auth.notes: API key generated in workspace and passed as Bearer token in HTTP Authorization header

evidence.snippet: This token must be passed inside the HTTP header of every request as a bearer token.

access.notes: API addon available on all plans (Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise); workspace admin must install addon first; members then self-serve generate API keys

evidence.snippet: you can generate API keys directly in Pumble. Here's how: Click on API Select Add API key
The Pumble API addon provides simple HTTP endpoints to handle
The rate limit is up to 1000 requests per minute per user.
With the incoming webhooks, you can easily post messages from other apps into Pumble.
With the Pumble Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, you can connect third-party AI agents (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Codex) to Pumble
Bring your AI agent into your Pumble workspace and streamline collaboration

buildability.rationale: Free self-serve API with documented REST endpoints, simple bearer token auth, official MCP server, and Composio has already built a production toolkit.
